notes: All body positions use the same orthographic scene and anatomical right gauntlet.
Flame Fan sustain is frames 5–7; restart/cancel/recovery requires an eventual gameplay animator.
Moving attack is a distinct locomotion loop; preview uses short blends for entry/exit, not a fifth skill.
Death is one-shot hold-last-frame. Optional co-op downed state would require a separate revive policy and clip.
VFX are deterministic vector-authored effects rasterized to transparent sheets; flame tongues remain stylized.
No numerical balance or gameplay integration.
